extra.final_summary: Found and fixed several data issues affecting the average body mass by species. First, 'body_mass_g' was stored as text with commas; converted to numeric. One row (id 10) had a body mass of 4,000,000 g, which is far outside the valid range [2500, 6500]; excluded that row. The 'sex' column had case variants 'MALE' and 'FEMALE'; normalized to 'male' and 'female'. The 'island' column had misspellings 'Bisco' and 'Torgerson'; corrected to 'Biscoe' and 'Torgersen'. After these fixes, computed the average body mass per species using 52 valid rows.
